copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在文档中应用复古暖色调的排版样式。
copy.tagline_en: Apply warm parchment-style typography to your documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a vintage warm-toned typography template for documents.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把你的内容排成暖羊皮纸底（#f5f4ed）、墨蓝单色强调（#1B365D）、单一衬线字体的单文件 HTML 文档，如 one-pager、长报告、信函等。
howto.when: 当你要做 one-pager、长报告、信函等严肃排版文档，而不是 dashboard 或网页时，交它接管。

howto.what_en: Claude outputs a single-file HTML document on warm parchment (#f5f4ed) with one ink-blue accent (#1B365D) and a single serif typeface, for one-pagers, long reports, letters and similar pages.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want a seriously typeset document — a one-pager, long report, letter or similar — rather than a dashboard or web page.
